title: Presentation Tile Play
description: Add a dev-only presentation play sandbox on @semio-tech/framework-playground for visually picking one-to-many morph tile parameters: grid seed, drag/resize overlapping tiles, copy LLM prompt to clipboard.
summary: Implemented Presentation Tile Play: dev sandbox on @semio-tech/framework-playground for one-to-many morph tile selection. Added TilePlay region to @semio-tech/framework-presentation-core (grid seeding, move/resize math, buildTileMorphPrompt + tests). Created @semio-tech/framework-presentation-play package (controller, grid engagement, tree panel, copy-prompt, Vite entry on port 6051). Added PresentationPlayHost to playground React renderer (FigureTilesSurfaceHost, boot/mount). Extended vite-elements-assets for presentation playEntryKind and aliases. Registered launch.json dev/build entries. Fixed paths (vite.config, globals.css, vitest aliases), exported buildPanelWindowBody from playground core, added workspace entries, demo figure in public/. Verified: core tests 48 pass, play tests 2 pass, build succeeds, dev server on :6051 serves app + demo image.
